Task Name: Blood Donor Management System (Project Summary)
Phase 1: Project Planning and Requirements
Conduct requirements analysis (donor, recipient roles, features, constraints)
Define project scope, objectives and deliverables
Document functional and non-functional requirements (SRS)
Feasibility analysis and tech-stack decision (FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Flutter)
Develop use cases and use-case diagram (donor, recipient, chat, requests)
Conduct risk assessment and mitigation plan
Build WBS and baseline project schedule in Microsoft Project
Set up Git repository, branching strategy and issue tracker
Define coding standards (Python/Dart style, folder structure, API conventions)
Milestone: Phase 1 complete
Phase 2: Database Design
Design ER diagram (users, blood requests, emergency requests, conversations, messages)
Normalize schema and define constraints, CHECK rules, foreign keys and updated_at triggers
Write PostgreSQL migration scripts (001-005) and migration runner
Define indexes for donor search (blood group, city, area)
Seed database with test donors, recipients and requests
Milestone: Database design complete
Phase 3: Backend Development (FastAPI)
Set up FastAPI project, environment config and async PostgreSQL connection pool (asyncpg)
Implement registration and login with JWT and bcrypt password hashing
Implement auth dependencies and protected-route middleware
Implement user profile endpoints (get / update profile)
Implement donor search endpoint (filter by blood group and location)
Implement blood-request CRUD endpoints (create, list, my requests, update, delete)
Implement conversations and messaging endpoints
Add request validation schemas (Pydantic) and error handling
Test APIs via Swagger/Postman and document endpoints
Milestone: Backend development complete
Phase 4: Frontend Development (Flutter Mobile App)
Design UI/UX wireframes and app theme
Set up Flutter project, app shell, navigation and providers
Implement API client, config, storage service and error handling
Build launch splash and onboarding screens
Build login and registration screens with auth provider
Build home shell with bottom navigation
Build profile and edit-profile screens
Build donor search and listing screen
Build blood-request list, detail and create screens
Build conversations list and chat thread screens
UI polish, common widgets, loading and empty states
Integrate all screens with backend and fix integration issues
Milestone: Frontend development complete
Phase 5: Testing
Prepare test plan, test cases and test data
Test authentication, JWT and protected routes
Test profile and donor search (blood group / location filters)
Test blood-request lifecycle (create, update, resolve, delete)
Test chat: conversations and messaging
Test security and data privacy (input validation, unauthorized access)
Test on multiple Android devices, screen sizes and poor network
Run end-to-end tests across app and backend
Fix mobile-app defects from test cycle
Fix backend defects from test cycle
Regression testing and final acceptance testing
Milestone: Testing sign-off
Phase 6: Backend Deployment (Render) and Handover
Create production PostgreSQL database on Render
Create Render web service and configure environment variables (DB, JWT)
Configure start command to run migrations on deploy and verify production schema
Deploy FastAPI backend to Render (HTTPS) and set health check
Point app to Render API and build signed Android release (APK)
Run production smoke tests (register, search, request, chat)
Set up keep-alive cron job (GitHub Actions) to prevent Render free-tier sleep
Milestone: Deployment complete
Write documentation (Render deployment guide, Android build guide, API, user guide)
Write final project report and prepare demonstration
Milestone: Final project submission
